# Chart of Accounts

The Chart of Accounts is the organized list of accounts used to classify financial transactions.

## Account categories

Common account categories include:

- Assets
- Liabilities
- Equity
- Income
- Expenses

## Account hierarchy

Accounts can be arranged in parent-child relationships to make financial reporting easier.

## Creating an account

1. Open the Chart of Accounts section.
2. Select **Add account**.
3. Enter the account name, code and account type.
4. Save the account.
